# Document a real read-only MCP inspection of the native SIGSEGV sample

Add a short reproducible transcript that initializes the local MCP stdio server and inspects the public native C SIGSEGV sample with its matching source bundle.

Start from README.md and docs/case-studies/c-sigsegv.md.

Acceptance:
- Use actual tool names returned by tools/list and record actual responses.
- Show the configured artifact root and a rejected out-of-root path.
- Keep native evidence, source verification, incomplete state and static candidates separate.
- Use the supported local source snapshot; no API key or third-party AI provider is required.
- Do not invent an automatic service-flow MCP tool that has not been implemented.
